Goal
* Please write a statement that explains the rules for the Fastest and Shortest modes, where reverse-engineering shouldn't be expected. If you want reverse-engineering to be possible, please enable the Reverse mode.

Input / Stub generator
* Please standardise the variable names: either OBJECT or OBJ.

Constraints
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]].

* Please change 50 to 10 as N never exceeds 10.

* Please use the variable name (OBJECT or OBJ) in the second constraint.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement.

Thanks.
Ok I'm on it, thanks for the clarification 😁
OK, let me know when you're done and I'll review it again.
I guess it's done, thx for taking the time to review it

The Goal section still doesn't explain what the 5 labels are and the criteria for classification. You have to write clear rules.

If you don't want to write any rules at all, please disable the Fastest and Shortest modes.
